q: 42 packs each contain 15 pens. How many pens are there?

steps.title: Calculate
steps.note: Find the total for these equal groups.

hint: What does the quantity 15 describe: one group, or the whole total?
method_note: Find the total for these equal groups.
error_note: Adding 42 and 15 does not count all the equal groups. Multiply 42 by 15.

q: 215 apples go into bags of 6. How many completely full bags can be made?

steps.title: Divide to find whole groups and the remainder
steps.note: 35 complete groups of 6, with 5 left over.

hint: Would a partly filled group of 6 count as a completely full group?
method_note: 35 complete groups of 6, with 5 left over. Only completely full groups count; leave the remainder out.
error_note: 36 groups would need 216, more than the 215 available. Count only full groups.

q: A painter charges £18 per hour for 32 hours, plus £120 for paint. Find the total bill.

steps.title: Calculate
steps.note: Find the total for these equal groups.

hint: What does the quantity 32 describe: one group, or the whole total? What will that first result represent?
method_note: Find the total for these equal groups. Include the extra amount once.
error_note: This is only the first cost. Include the extra £120 once.
